austin.summary: Austin, drafting 5th meant waiting, and waiting paid off — Eric at pick #16 ranks 1, the steal of this draft. You're sitting at rank 2 (tied) of 5 with 24 counted points, with the leader at 28 and 48 points still on the table. The Torch Collector badge says you've watched 2 torches snuffed, and Jenna at pick #6 ranking 17 still stings. But 2 of 4 remain. You're very much in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric and Carter are both sitting at 7 pts, rank 1 of 21, grade A — a mental health counselor and a livestock farmer doing the heavy lifting side by side.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: A draft GPA of 2 reflects the early damage: Jenna went 4th voted out with 4 pts and Linnea 6th voted out with 6 pts, both graded F.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: After an Ep 3 high of +8 and an Ep 4 low of +3, the question is whether Eric's fast bonds and Carter's competitive streak can close that four-point gap on the leader.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this whole season — Aaliyah went home Ep 1, and that First Blood badge is yours forever. Add a Torch Collector badge for 2 torches snuffed and a 2.25 draft GPA, and yes, you're rank 5 of 5 with 19 counted points. But hold on. Your pick #18, Kilby, ranks 1. Cristian ranks 1. There are 48 points still on the table and the leader has 28. You are very much alive.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian and Kilby are both sitting at 7 pts and rank 1 of 21, two grade-A engines on Dina doing every bit of the lifting.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung — 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, grade F, gone first — and Alexis followed her out in Ep 5 with 5 pts.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether your Dina pair can keep stacking weeks like Ep 3 (+6) and chase down that 28.

tami.summary: Tami, you drafted first and you drafted bold — three of your five are still out there on Mergedtribe, and you're sitting at rank 2 of 5 with 36 counted points off a raw 38. Sharonda at pick #21 as the leftover is the steal of this entire draft, and Ep 6 gave you your best haul at +12. The leader has 44. There are 55 points still on the table. Game on.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Jelly, Mike and Sharonda are all tied at 11 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — three co-leaders hauling your scoreboard together.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 scored 3 pts for a rank of 18 of 21 and an F grade, and Rob's 2 pts became your dropped score under the best-4 rule.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Idol Whisperer badge says this roster has found 2 idols and advantages — watch whether that hardware turns into points at the merge.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and came away with a roster that swings hard in both directions. Your draft GPA is 1.75, but Brady at pick #19 ranks 1 — that's larceny. You sit rank 4 of 5 with 30 counted points, two of four still in the game, and the leader at 44. Ep 6 gave you +8; Ep 2 only +3. With 40 points still on the table, you are absolutely still in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin and Brady are tied atop the whole cast at 11 pts apiece, rank 1 of 21, and both are still out there playing — that's your engine, and your Idol Whisperer badge says they've found 2 idols and advantages across the roster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana at pick #12 was the reach of your draft, ranking 20 with 1 pts and an F grade after going out 2nd in Ep 2, and Ori's 7 pts and D grade ended in Ep 6 — hence that Torch Collector badge with 2 torches snuffed.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Watch whether Kristin and Brady can keep splitting the top spot on the merged tribe, because with 40 points still on the table, your gap to the leader's 44 is nothing a couple of big episodes can't fix.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted fourth and somehow walked off with the whole barn. Rank 1 of 5, 28 counted points, 4 of 4 still in the game, and seven boots have come and gone without one of them being yours — that's Untouchable, and you've co-led or led after every single elimination. A 3.75 draft GPA, two idols found, and Ep 3 handed you your best week at +8. Remarkable.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: There's no passenger here — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are each sitting on 7 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a four-way engine room that's kept you Wire-to-Wire.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: If you're hunting for a soft spot, Lewis Kelly's B grade is the only mark below an A on this roster, and Ep 1 was your quietest week at +4.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 86 points still on the table and the leader has 28 — so watch whether your Idol Whisperer crew, already 2 found, keeps turning advantages into separation.
